site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.domain-heading: Adhikaarika GFTV saitlu globalfurry.tv ledaa gftv.asia to mugustaayi
official.domain-body: Chirunaamaanu chivari nunchi chadavandi: Modati ontari slaashku mundunna chivari chukka daggara choodandi. Vere denitonainaa mugise sait GFTV kaadu, chirunaamaalo mundu aa peru kanipinchinaa sare.
official.secure-body: Taalan gurtu kosan, ledaa chirunaamaa modatlo https:// kosan choodandi. Vyaktigata vivaraalanu surakshita kanekshan dvaaraa adhikaarika saitlo maatrame panchukondi.

how.spot.title: Chirunavvunu gurtinchandi
how.spot.body: Kaardu, laanyaard ledaa bordu meeda HelloSmile kosan choodandi. Adi ekkada unte, ade HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Halo cheppandi
how.hello.body: Daggariki vachchi haay cheppandi. Meeku ippatike evarainaa telisi undaalani HelloSpot-lo evaroo aashincharu.

how.friend.body: Mee chuttoo unnavaallanu kalavandi, tadupari meetlo vetakadaaniki okarito bayaluderandi.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) Singapoor kendrangaa panichese, Aasiyaalone atipedda pharree phyaandam vaartaa chhaanel.
about.body-2: Ee roju, repu andaroo mechchukunelaa pharreela edugudalanu memu choopistaan; prajalu okari gurinchi okaru telusukuni arthan chesukunenduku vedikalanu erpaatu chestaan.
about.body-3: Svadeshan nunchi pradhaana khandaala varaku vistarinchina GFTV brundan antarjaateeya, bahula saanskrutika, bahubhaashaa brundan.
